propositions: Two capability decisions (output_mode and prompt caching) incorrectly match provider names as strings instead of reading ModelProfile fields, causing Bedrock-hosted Claude to silently lose caching and forced-output paths

The current hardcoded _NATIVE_OUTPUT_PROVIDERS frozenset and startswith('anthropic') checks must be replaced by profile field inspection to support Bedrock-hosted models whose capability flags differ from direct Anthropic API

capabilities_for() must accept both model objects and lazy model strings (from S1 providers), reading .profile directly from objects and resolving profiles via _PROFILE_RESOLVERS for strings without importing vendor SDKs
A rebar override table using profile-type predicates (not string matching) must force Claude on both direct-Anthropic and Bedrock hosts to PromptedOutput, per current tests and upstream guidance

The profile-derived cache_settings_for(prompt_cache_style) function must route to AnthropicModelSettings or BedrockModelSettings with instruction/tool-definition caching enabled based on style, replacing _anthropic_cache_settings

supports_thinking field on ModelCapabilities must be derived from profile but NOT consumed by output_mode (which uses caller-supplied thinking param), reserving it as load-bearing provenance for S5 signed verdict payloads
